law_name: Law No. 7 of 2002 on the Protection of Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (anonymous, pseudonymous, audiovisual and collective works: 50 years from first publication)
digital_protection: WCT party: anti-circumvention protection required by WCT art. 11 (national rule not checked)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list: personal use, quotation, teaching illustration, library/education copies (arts 18, 21)
enforcement_body: Ministry of Commerce and Industry - Intellectual Property Protection Department
